steps: Join orders and order_items on order_id, filtering for non-canceled and non-unavailable orders.
Calculate total revenue by summing order_items.price per order.
Compute the average of these per-order revenues.

data.text: I'll compute the average order value using the standard revenue definition (sum of order_items.price, excluding canceled and unavailable orders).

args.sql:
SELECT 
    AVG(oi.price) as avg_order_value
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
args.purpose: Average order value using standard revenue definition
